worldcombat.skill.willowisp.summary: Send a cold wisp along your aim: with an enemy selected it tracks it to a limited degree, while an empty aim or a point makes it fly straight and a wall snuffs it out. It deals no direct damage, only burns - damage over time that halves physical attack. Its turning is limited, so distance and evasive movement can shake it off.
Send a wisp up to %1$s blocks, flying at %2$s blocks per tick; with no entity selected it flies straight along your aim.
On a catch the target burns for %1$s seconds; the wisp turns at most %2$s degrees per tick, so outrunning or rounding cover shakes it off.
While burned, physical attack damage is halved and the target loses about 1/16 of its maximum health every 5 seconds (at least 1 point); Fire-type and otherwise burn-immune targets are not ignited.
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.use.0: Burn a target from a distance
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.use.1: Blunt a target that presses in with physical attacks
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.use.2: Make the target dodge the flame and give up its ground
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.preference.s: On: the wisp flies faster and turns tighter (speed x1.35, turn x1.25) but the burn is shorter (x0.7) - it lands sooner and dies sooner. Off: it coils, flying slower but burning longer (x1.15), holding the target down.
worldcombat.skill.willowisp.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of casting. Larger values chase harder and lose the wisp in the open more often.

On: the wisp is aimed first at targets whose physical attack clearly beats their special attack, or that are pressing in for melee; off: every unburned enemy is treated alike. The wisp deals no direct damage, so this only changes who gets burned.
When on, the user may leave its post to cast; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
